orbNative.micUsageDescription: Vitana needs your microphone so you can talk to her. It's only on while a conversation is open.

status.unavailable: Vitana isn't available in this app version yet.

rationale.title: Talk to Vitana
rationale.body: So Vitana can hear you, the app needs access to your microphone. The microphone is only on while the conversation is open.

denied.body: Allow microphone access in Settings so you can talk to Vitana.

a11y.restart: Start a new conversation with Vitana

bench.title: Voice echo test
bench.intro: Checks echo cancellation with no network and no conversation. Put your phone down, set a normal volume and stay quiet during the echo test.
bench.noisyRoom: The room is louder than the close threshold, so the result is stricter than needed.
bench.unavailable: The echo test is only available in development and test versions of the app.
